results.test: Session budget cap: once the session's spend reaches the budget, the next run is refused before any model call
Per-run token cap (lowered to 1,500 for the test): the seller flow stops with a cap instead of continuing to spend

detail.how: the remaining token budget is passed to every agent call (pydantic-ai UsageLimits); the call that crosses it is stopped ('agent_cap') and no further call is made
detail.caveat: the tokens of the call that crossed the cap are not written to token_usage (pydantic-ai raises before returning usage): at most one call per run goes unrecorded
